id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

edge.description: Whether or not the shape is an edge

vertex.description: Whether or not the shape is a vertex

srid.description:
Coordinate system for points stored in geometry column.

Interesting SRIDS:
   0 (Unknown)
   4326 (e.g. WGS84 Lat/Long - Used by Google Earth)
   3857 (e.g. Spherical Mercator - Used by Google Maps)

x.description: The X coordinate of the point. In most long/lat systems, this is the longitude.

y.description: The Y coordinate of the point. In most long/lat systems, this is the latitude.

minimized.description: Whether or not the node should be minimized when rendered on the {@link UiSdlDiagram}

expandable.description: Whether or not the node is expandable. Will determine if a collapse/expand toggle is rendered with the node.

expanded.description: Whether or not the node is expanded.

connectable.description:
Whether or not the node should be connectable when rendered on the {@link UiSdlDiagram}.
Determines if new edges can be created between 2 given nodes via drag and drop.

diagramProps.description: Props passed to SDLDiagram by {@link UiSdlDiagram}, which the node can make use of.

diagramScale.description:
The current scale of the diagram. Decimal representation of the % zoom shown in the UI (80% -> .8, 110% -> 1.1).
It is up to the node to decide how to handle it.

nodeActions.description:
Actions associated with the node. If utilizing {@link UiSdlActionGroup#dropdownContent}, when a dropdown
item is clicked, the actionSuffix will be a concatenation with `_` of the {@link UiSdlActionGroup#actionSuffix} and
the item's {@link UiSdlAction#actionSuffix}, ex: `DROPDOWN_ITEM`.

contextMenuItems.description: A list of context menu items that will appear when the node is right-clicked

shapeId.description: The id of the shape being rendered

visible.description: Whether or not the node should be visible

title.description: The title of the node. Usually a {@link Type} name.

subtitle.description: The subtitle of the node. Rendered inline to the right of the title

subtitleTooltipKey.description: The {@link Translation} key for the node's subtitle tooltip

iconClass.description: The icon class of the node. Rendered inline to the left of the title

colorClass.description: The color class of the node

errors.description: The add ons for the node

childContainerScrollTop.description:
The current `scrollTop` value of the DOM element containing the nodes {@link #children}.
This is used to preserve the scroll offset after moving/collapsing/expanding the node.

moveEdgesOnScroll.description: The function in charge of moving edges when expanded node fields are scrolled through.

height.description: The height of the node when rendered. Used to aid layout algorithms

width.description: The width of the node when rendered. Used to aid layout algorithms

minifiedWidth.description: The width of a minimized node

minifiedHeight.description: The height of a minified node

collapsedHeight.description: Height of the node in pixels when not expanded

expandedHeight.description:
Height of the node in pixels when expanded. We need this to be accurate even when the node is collapsed
so that edges are drawn in the correct place.

spacingBetweenChildren.description: Spacing between child fields in pixels

spacingBeforeChildren.description: Extra spacing in pixels between the first child field and the end of the un-expanded parent node

spacingAfterChildren.description: Spacing in pixels between the last child and the end of the expanded node

maximumChildrenDisplayed.description: Sets the maximum number of children displayed when expanded, which effectively determines the maximum node height

borderClass.description: Sets border properties around the node

backgroundClass.description: Sets a background properties on the node

layeredIconClass.description: Layers an icon on top of the node icon

selected.description: Whether the shape is currently selected or not

children.description: The optional children this node can render. Will be visually contained inside the node.

title:
Specifies all of the props needed to render an expandable diagram node.
Consumers are expected to manage the `expanded` state themselves.
name: UiSdlDiagramExpandableNode
